newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $4.1 bln for week of May 5.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $4.1 bln for week of May 5.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of May 5 are expected to total $4.1 billion in 102 sales, the largest dollar total since $4.5 billion was offered the week of April 7, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $3.3 billion in 42 sales, with a $486 million San Antonio, Texas, deal through PaineWebber Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 60 sales totaling $749 million are on the schedule. A $173 million Tennessee deal on Wednesday is the largest.

An additional 11 sales totaling $646 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds this week depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
